Compute total revenue for March 2026 (month "2026-03") per customer billing region, counting ONLY orders with status "completed" (exclude refunded and pending). Report each region's total in integer cents. When done, submit {"NA": <cents>, "EU": <cents>, "APAC": <cents>} via submit_result.

Reasoning.summary: Let me start by listing orders for March 2026, then fetch each order's details and customer regions. I'll use the compose tool to do this efficiently in one script.

local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }
local page = 1
local customer_cache = {}
local completed_count = 0
local total_orders = 0
repeat
  local r = tool('list_orders', { month = '2026-03', page = page })
  total_orders = r.total_items
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local o = tool('get_order', { id = it.id })
    if o.status == 'completed' then
      completed_count = completed_count + 1
      local cid = it.customer_id or o.customer_id
      local region = customer_cache[cid]
      if not region then
        local c = tool('get_customer', { id = cid })
        region = c.billing_region or c.region
        customer_cache[cid] = region
      end
      totals[region] = (totals[region] or 0) + o.amount_cents
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages
return { totals = totals, total_orders = total_orders, completed_count = completed_count, pages = r.total_pages }
